description: Search the public directory (opt-in venues only) by location, opening status, cuisine, dietary options, declared attributes and ordering channel. Neutral ranking (AI-K6): distance in 0.5 km bands when `near` is given → availability (open now first; unknown hours before closed) → profile freshness (owner-verified within 90 days first) → name. Subscription tier never affects order. Cuisine, dietary and other attributes are owner declarations, not verified facts; venues without a declaration are excluded only when an attribute filter is used, and venues without coordinates only when `near` is used. Returns slug, name, city, country, distance_km, is_open_now (serve-time, in the venue's own timezone; null when hours are unknown), channels (order · reservation · pickup · delivery), declared attributes, freshness and the menu URL. Paginated.

attributes.description: Any declared attribute token (meals, family, outdoor, accessibility, cuisine, dietary).

channel.description: order = digital ordering at the table; reservation; pickup = takeaway; delivery = venue's own delivery.

cuisine.description: All listed cuisines must be declared by the venue.

near.description: Search centre. Venues without coordinates are excluded when set.

open_now.description: Only venues open right now in their own timezone; venues with unknown hours are excluded when true.

q.description: Free text over name and description (min 2 chars).

name: search_restaurants
